e: I will never forget this day.
I won't go to work tomorrow.
I won't drink coffee after today.
I won't sell this car.

q: أَنَا لَنْ ___ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ عَشْرِ دَقَائِقَ.
e: I won't wait more than ten minutes.

q: أَنَا لَنْ ___ فِي هَذَا الْفُنْدُقِ مَرَّةً أُخْرَى.
e: I won't sleep in this hotel again.
I won't tell anyone.

q: أَنْتَ لَنْ ___ فِي الْوَقْتِ إِذَا لَمْ تُسْرِعْ.
e: You won't arrive on time if you don't hurry.

q: يَا أَحْمَدُ، أَنْتَ لَنْ ___ هَذَا الْكِتَابَ.
e: Ahmad, you won't understand this book.

q: أَنْتَ لَنْ ___ شَيْئًا الْيَوْمَ، هَذِهِ هَدِيَّتِي.
e: You won't pay anything today, this is my treat.

q: يَا عَلِيُّ، أَنْتَ لَنْ ___ فِي هَذَا الْبَرْدِ.
e: Ali, you won't swim in this cold.

q: أَنْتَ لَنْ ___ مَكَانًا أَجْمَلَ مِنْ هَذَا.
e: You won't find a nicer place than this.

q: يَا سَمِيرُ، أَنْتَ لَنْ ___ الْبَيْتَ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَأْكُلَ.
e: Samir, you won't leave the house before you eat.

q: أَنْتَ لَنْ ___ فِي الِامْتِحَانِ بِدُونِ دِرَاسَةٍ.
e: You won't pass the exam without studying.
Sara, you won't travel alone.

q: أَنْتِ لَنْ ___ هَذَا الْفُسْتَانَ، هُوَ صَغِيرٌ.
e: You won't wear this dress, it is too small.

q: يَا لَيْلَى، أَنْتِ لَنْ ___ هَذِهِ الْكَعْكَةَ كُلَّهَا!
e: Layla, you won't eat this whole cake!

q: يَا أُمِّي، لَنْ ___ شَيْئًا الْيَوْمَ، سَنَأْكُلُ فِي الْمَطْعَمِ.
e: Mum, you won't cook anything today, we will eat at the restaurant.
You won't forget your new friend.

q: يَا مَرْيَمُ، أَنْتِ لَنْ ___ الْعَمَلَ قَبْلَ السَّاعَةِ الْخَامِسَةِ.
e: Maryam, you won't leave work before five o'clock.
You won't wait here long.

q: يَا هُدَى، أَنْتِ لَنْ ___ هَذِهِ الْحَقِيبَةَ الثَّقِيلَةَ.
e: Huda, you won't carry this heavy bag.
You won't cry at the end of the film.
Reem, you won't know the answer.

q: يَا سَلْمَى، لَنْ ___ إِلَى الْمَدْرَسَةِ غَدًا، إِنَّهُ يَوْمُ عُطْلَةٍ.
e: Salma, you won't go to school tomorrow, it is a holiday.
My father won't sell his old car.

q: هُوَ لَنْ ___ مِنَ الْعَمَلِ قَبْلَ الْمَسَاءِ.
e: He won't be back from work before the evening.
The manager won't speak with us today.
My brother won't play in the match tomorrow.
The child won't sleep without his mother.

q: مُحَمَّدٌ لَنْ ___ أَحَدًا إِلَى عِيدِ مِيلَادِهِ.
e: Muhammad won't invite anyone to his birthday.
He won't call us before tomorrow.
My mother will never leave our old house.
She won't travel by plane, she is afraid of flying.
My sister won't get married in the summer.
Sara won't come to the party tonight.
The teacher won't give an exam this week.
My grandmother won't go up to the fifth floor.

q: هِيَ لَنْ ___ فِي الْحَفْلَةِ، صَوْتُهَا مُتْعَبٌ.
e: She won't sing at the party, her voice is tired.
We won't buy this house.

q: نَحْنُ لَنْ ___ فِي هَذَا الْمَطْعَمِ مَرَّةً أُخْرَى.
e: We won't eat at this restaurant again.

q: نَحْنُ لَنْ ___ إِلَى الْبَيْتِ قَبْلَ مُنْتَصَفِ اللَّيْلِ.
e: We won't go back home before midnight.
We won't travel next week.
We won't talk about this subject.
We won't visit my grandfather this month.
My husband and I won't dance at the party.

q: يَا أَوْلَادُ، لَنْ ___ إِلَى الْحَدِيقَةِ الْيَوْمَ.
e: Children, you won't go out to the park today.

q: أَنْتُمْ لَنْ ___ هَذَا الطَّعَامَ، هُوَ حَارٌّ جِدًّا.
e: You won't like this food, it is very spicy.

q: يَا طُلَّابُ، لَنْ ___ الْقَامُوسَ فِي الِامْتِحَانِ.
e: Students, you won't use the dictionary in the exam.

q: أَنْتُمْ لَنْ ___ فِي الْوَقْتِ بِهَذِهِ السُّرْعَةِ.
e: You won't arrive on time at this speed.
Guys, you won't succeed without training.
You will never forget this trip.

q: يَا أَصْدِقَائِي، لَنْ ___ شَيْئًا، الطَّعَامُ مَجَّانِيٌّ.
e: My friends, you won't pay anything, the food is free.

q: أَنْتُمْ لَنْ ___ فِي هَذَا الْبَحْرِ، الْمَوْجُ عَالٍ.
e: You won't swim in this sea, the waves are high.

q: يَا أَوْلَادُ، لَنْ ___ التِّلْفَازَ قَبْلَ الْوَاجِبِ.
e: Children, you won't watch TV before your homework.

q: أَنْتُمْ لَنْ ___ فِي هَذِهِ الشَّقَّةِ الصَّغِيرَةِ.
e: You won't live in this small flat.

q: يَا طُلَّابُ، لَنْ ___ الدَّرْسَ بِدُونِ تَرْكِيزٍ.
e: Students, you won't understand the lesson without concentrating.
They won't come to the party.
The children won't sleep before ten.
My friends won't visit my house this week.
They won't travel with us this time.
The workers won't work on Friday.
The students won't start the exam before ten.
They will never know the truth.
Our neighbours won't leave the neighbourhood.
They won't answer your questions.
The children won't eat the vegetables.
They won't help anyone.

q: يَا بَنَاتُ، لَنْ ___ إِلَى الْبَحْرِ وَحْدَكُنَّ.
e: Girls, you won't go to the sea alone.
You won't forget this story.

q: يَا طَالِبَاتُ، لَنْ ___ الْهَاتِفَ فِي الصَّفِّ.
e: Students, you won't use your phones in class.
You won't sing at the theatre tomorrow.
The girls won't dance at the party.

q: هُنَّ لَنْ ___ إِلَى الْبَيْتِ قَبْلَ اللَّيْلِ.
e: They won't come back home before dark.

q: الطَّالِبَاتُ لَنْ ___ فِي السَّكَنِ الْجَامِعِيِّ هَذِهِ السَّنَةَ.
e: The female students won't live in student housing this year.
My sisters won't go out with us to the restaurant.
The two boys won't be afraid of the dark.
The two girls won't stay at home alone.
You two won't lose this match.
I won't change my mind.
He won't stop talking.
The manager won't let us leave early.
She won't win the prize this year.
We won't move to another city.

q: يَا مَرْيَمُ، لَنْ ___ عَمَلَكِ بِسَبَبِ هَذَا الْخَطَأِ.
e: Maryam, you won't lose your job because of this mistake.

q: أَنْتِ لَنْ ___ فِي هَذَا الْعَمَلِ طَوِيلًا.
e: You won't carry on in this job for long.

q: أَنْتُمْ لَنْ ___ فِي الْمُسَابَقَةِ هَذِهِ السَّنَةَ.
e: You won't take part in the competition this year.
You won't keep this secret.
They won't move all these books.
The students won't reply to the manager's messages.
